column3: Close to the Hebrew; “in a generation and a generation” is rendered “in all generations.”
Close to the Hebrew; “from antiquity until perpetuity” is rendered “from everlasting to everlasting.”
“Crushed matter” is rendered “dust,” and the past “you said” as present “say.”
NASB renders “you flood them; they are sleep” as “You have swept them away like a flood, they fall asleep.” The meaning of the Hebrew is uncertain.
Close to the Hebrew; “we come to an end” is rendered “we have been consumed.”
“Concealed [sins]” is rendered “secret sins,” and “the light of your face” as “the light of Your presence.”
Close to the Hebrew; “they turn” is rendered “have declined.”
Close to the Hebrew; “in them [are] seventy years” is rendered “they contain seventy years,” and “toil and trouble” as “labor and sorrow.”
The Hebrew says “and like your fear, your fury”; NASB adds “according to the fear that is due You.”
NASB adds “to You”: “present to You a heart of wisdom” for “bring a heart of wisdom.”
“Have compassion on” is rendered “be sorry for,” and “return!” as “Do return.”
Close to the Hebrew; “covenant loyalty” is rendered “lovingkindness.”
Close to the Hebrew; “we saw trouble” is rendered “we have seen evil.”
Close to the Hebrew; the plural “deeds” is rendered “work.”
“The kindness of the Lord” is rendered “the favor of the Lord,” and “establish on us” as “confirm for us.”
